title: RAS Model Setup: R3 to R2 Projection
content: Model: L1 local meaning field simplified as 3D Euclidean space R^3 with meaning density rho(x,y,z). L0 physical observation screen is 2D plane R^2. Projection map pi: R^3 -> R^2 defined as linear projection pi(x,y,z) = (x,y). Purpose: calculate local curvature (heat tax) and global topological deficit (meaning void) when projecting non-trivial topological meaning network (CMN) and gradient field from 3D to 2D.
